Maya: Short thread to capture postmortem follow-ups from the KV OOM last night. Need explicit owners + quick ETAs.
Chris: Main symptom recap: shard residency drifts up after ~36h, fragmentation spikes.
Oliver: I uploaded heap maps and a slab heatmap: https://redwood-internal/kv/heapmaps/416999. Hot path in batch serializer.
Jamie: Quick mitigations I'd push: resident cap canary and slab reclaim A/B. Owner?
Maya: Draft actions: resident_cap canary (owner: Chris, ETA 48h); profiling sweep 6 hosts (owner: Oliver, ETA 72h); slab_reclaim experiment (owner: Jamie, ETA 5d); eviction-age term + alert (owner: Maya, ETA 2w); artifacts retention 14d (owner: Priya, ETA 24h).
Chris: I'll do canary config and 6h synthetic run, rollback ready.
Oliver: Profiling job will collect jemalloc stats, /proc/smaps, and pprof; posting script to ops repo.
Jamie: Reclaim reduces residency locally but increases p99 slightly; will run A/B and report acceptance thresholds.
Priya: I'll open the tracker PR and add a Monday recurring check for 4 weeks. Adding acceptance criteria for each action.
Maya: PostmortemBot: link PM-2026-KV-RESIDENCY.
PostmortemBot: auto-note: PM-2026-KV-RESIDENCY linked to thread 4169990001.
All: Signed. Will update tracker on progress and surface any ETA slips here.
